name: vstack
description: Visual Stack is interactive wireframing for Claude Code. Build a screen from a prompt, screenshot, reference site, or design system; comment directly on the result; and receive each revision in the same browser workspace. It can also review a running app or public website route by route, turning feedback on your own app into source-code changes. Wireframes are self-contained HTML and local review state stays in the project. Earlier project-planning experiments remain bundled for compatibility but are not part of the current product offer.
